bounds.domain: One staging destination, two privilege modes, two native install modes, valid/refused admission, and an absent/existing output. Retries discard unpublished private staging; a published destination is immutable.
bounds.scope: Actual existing Node fixtures replay renderer and filesystem outcomes; the full native admission and Python suites retain byte/path/permission refusals. Signer tooling is controlled. Raw Python finalization is not an atomic transaction; only its pre-write refusals and successful outputs are covered. Process death during writes, simultaneous cross-process publishers, Android loading and device qualification remain outside this model. The separately recorded pinned Soong Go suite checks compiler acceptance and physical install paths.

assumptions: The selected input and destination stay fixed, local I/O succeeds, and admission, rendering, publication and refusal actions are weakly fair. No external signer or provider success is assumed.
Without fairness, the pending call may stutter forever.
